arguments.summary: A multi-stage compromise was initiated via a phishing email that delivered a malicious payload to host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). The attacker executed a PowerShell-based initial access vector from within Outlook, deployed a Cobalt Strike beacon via an unsigned DLL in the user's Temp directory, established C2 communication with a known-bad external IP, and performed lateral movement attempts. The source IP in the initial alert (10.0.5.14) was a misattribution; the true compromised host was 10.0.5.42. UEBA analysis confirmed low user anomaly score, indicating the compromise leveraged legitimate credentials without significant behavioral deviation. No privilege escalation or data exfiltration was observed during the monitoring window.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        miter = ["T1071.001", "T1218.011"]
    strings:
        $a = { FF E0 } // jmp eax
        $b = { 60 64 A1 00 00 00 00 6A 00 68 } // PEB access
        $c = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $d = "x64" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
